commons.description: The group is located in PhuKhao Thong sub-district, Phra Nakorn Si Ayutthaya district. It was founded by a group of housewives with an objective of carrying on an intention of their ancestors who had once resided and made a living along the Chao Phraya River for over a hundred years.
